text:
nina: AE flagged Marlin Labs want to run a 2-week POC with a customer-finetuned model `marlin-13b-ft`. They require Private deploy, customer-managed KMS, embeddings + chat, and P95 latency <180ms at 35 rps. Asking for catalog onboarding path and infra/security blockers.

sal: Do they provide tokenizer and artifact format? Any adapter layers?

nina: They sent `marlin-13b-ft.gguf` and `tokenizer.json`. Tokenizer is modified BPE, custom eos token. They want deterministic generation and exact-repeatability for evals.

ops-bot: [artifact-scan] marlin-13b-ft.gguf: tokenizer.json present, vocab 49k, special token mapping non-standard (<|eos_custom|>), model loads OK. Adapter: none detected. License check: ok.

sal: Runtime note: custom eos needs verification. If mismatch, shim possible but adds latency. Deterministic = temp=0, top_p=1. We should recommend running a tokenization compatibility test before onboarding.

nina: Customer asked about fallback to smaller distilled variant if capacity saturated. Also asked about audit logging for each request.

ops-bot: [policy] Private deploy KMS requirement: provide Key ARN with policy granting RedwoodDeployRole kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey OR use customer-managed deploy agent. Audit logs: we can emit metadata-only logs by default; raw input logging requires explicit retention and masking agreement.

sal: Perf: 13B at 35 rps P95<180ms likely needs dedicated warm pool with 2-3 replicas, or int8 quantization to reduce footprint. Suggest offering embeddings on a 6-7B embed-only variant to lower cost.

deploy-bot: [ticket] Created SW-4720 "Marlin Labs POC  marlin-13b-ft onboarding" assigned to sal,nina. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-4720

nina: Action items: Sal -> tokenizer compatibility check + quick eval against their prompt set. Ops -> confirm KMS config snippet and audit log options. I'll draft SOW with fallback behavior and pricing delta for int8 vs fp16.

sal: Will run token check and small regression eval now; will post results in Jira.

ops-bot: [note] If customer requests HSM-backed keys, escalate to security. Region for private deploy must be confirmed to match customer's data residency.

nina: Thanks team  will update AE and loop in security if needed.
